page.notes: Greek in the second paragraph (Homer quotation, "Σὼ τε ἀὶ᾽ ὁρχομένω") is uncertain; the verse is hard to read letter by letter. The Greek after "Diuina.)" is also uncertain, and the first word is marked [?]. The second "Δαίμονες" is a printed correction and is partly illegible. The paragraph ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, with "aut saltem" running on from the page. The ")" after "fuere" and "Membrum" is printed in the column text, not as a marginal note.
